title: The Sheriff's Request to Mountain Tim
overview: After a shocking end to the 1st STAGE, abnormal murders unfold. Legendary cowboy Mountain Tim steps in to investigate as the tense 2nd STAGE begins.

title: The Desert-Born Outlaws
overview: At camp, Johnny catches a glimpse of Gyro's past. Then the Boomboom Family strikes with an otherworldly power. The duo escape — or so they think.

title: The Devil's Palm
overview: Caught in the Boombooms' trap, a magnetic force threatens to tear Johnny, Gyro and Mountain Tim apart. They learn about "Stands" and Johnny's body reacts.

title: The Terrorist from a Faraway Country
overview: At a checkpoint, Oye — a man who knows Gyro's past — confronts the duo. His power to turn anything he touches into a bomb leaves them with nowhere to run.

title: Gyro Zeppeli’s Destiny
overview: Wounded and weary, the duo finds the Zombie Horse. As Gyro patches himself up, memories surface — revealing a family legacy steeped in duty and sacrifice.

title: Tusk (1)
overview: Near Monument Valley, Gyro vanishes into thin air. Alone and under attack, Johnny suspects the mummified arm in his possession has made them both targets.

title: Tusk (2)
overview: Johnny awakens a new power and reaches a shocking revelation about the race. Finding hope in the Corpse, he counterattacks to rescue Gyro and protect it.

title: Frightening Monsters (1)
overview: In the Rocky Mountains, Johnny and Gyro find an injured Diego — and odd changes in his body. When they shelter in a village, a terrifying threat emerges.
